semantic_comparison_draft.domains: T is first-countable topological; Omega is measurable with probability P; E is compact topological and measurable, with opens of E×E measurable in the product sigma algebra; X:T→Omega→E; c:E×E→NNReal is continuous.
semantic_comparison_draft.quantifiers: All spaces, structures, P, X, slice-measurability and common-event path-continuity data are fixed; then every continuous c with diagonal zero and every fixed s in T has the neighborhood-filter transport limit.
semantic_comparison_draft.assumptions: Every time slice X_t is measurable; P-almost every entire path is continuous on all T; c is continuous, finite nonnegative and zero on every diagonal point. No joint measurability, separation, symmetry, metric structure or optimizing coupling is assumed.
semantic_comparison_draft.conclusion: t↦C_c(mu_t,mu_s) tends to zero as t→s in the topology of the extended nonnegative reals.
semantic_comparison_draft.scopes: One P-full path event, all deterministic slices, every fixed base time s, no horizon/order restriction and no uniform-in-s rate. The output is deterministic convergence, not an a.e. random-variable limit.
semantic_comparison_draft.constant_dependencies: No bound constant in the statement. Compactness internally bounds c uniformly over the state product and all probability laws; no rate is claimed.

semantic_comparison_draft.typed_notes: General-measure couplings coincide with source probability couplings because the first marginal has mass one.

semantic_comparison_draft.domains: The same T, Omega, P, E, X and finite continuous nonnegative cost c; F is a normed additive commutative group only; U has product-topological domain T×E and L is real.
semantic_comparison_draft.quantifiers: All common data, then F, U and L; one hbound is universal over all p,q∈T×E. The conclusion is continuity at every q and hence on the entire domain.
semantic_comparison_draft.assumptions: Common slice/path/cost conditions plus the pointwise all-pairs norm bound with this one L. No L≥0, prior regularity of U, target completeness/scalar action or separate cost-finiteness assumption.
semantic_comparison_draft.conclusion: U is jointly continuous from T×E to the norm topology on F.
semantic_comparison_draft.scopes: Only path continuity is a.e.; the hbound is pointwise for all pairs and the conclusion is everywhere deterministic continuity, with no time horizon. Projection of the first theorem handles the product filter without first countability of E.
semantic_comparison_draft.constant_dependencies: L may depend on U and the earlier fixed data but cannot vary with p,q. There is no new constant, modulus or convergence rate.
semantic_comparison_draft.proof: Apply first theorem to pointwise c² and compose with time projection (60–70); convert ENNReal limit using toReal at zero, then Real.sqrt, add point-cost limit and multiply by arbitrary L (71–80); squeeze the nonnegative norm using hbound (81–82).
